biotools.summary: Sensommatic is an automated pipeline for mining and predicting sensory receptor genes from whole genome assemblies, utilizing BLAST and AUGUSTUS. It's designed to overcome limitations of reference-based annotation tools and can be extended to non-vertebrate species.
